summary: Frontend-only regression + 3 new features tested. All 3 new features PASS: (1) Courier motor-card LND-004 renders both green CHAT WA + yellow DITERIMA buttons in 2-col grid; CHAT WA opens wa.me URL with correctly URL-encoded 'Halo Ratna Dewi, kurir LaundryMax' template. (2) Admin Overview shows piutang-widget below staff-performance-card with total 'Rp 241.000' and all 5 rows (LND-006/007/009/012/014) each with wa-tagihan button. (3) wa-tagihan-LND-006 opens wa.me URL with 'Halo Rina Permata, cucian LaundryMax (Order LND-006) sudah selesai. Total tagihan Rp 30.000. Mohon segera dilunasi ya.' (URL-encoded) — matches spec. POSScreen.jsx refactor: no regressions — register-regular-button and register-member-button open their respective dialogs; customer-name-input 'Budi Santoso' triggers member-active-badge with 'Gold' and '12.5 kg'; all data-testids intact; imports from /components/pos/* resolve cleanly.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warning on initial mount — cosmetic console noise, chart still renders correctly

critical_code_review_comments: CourierDashboard.jsx line 636: phone is stripped of non-digits — for '0817-xxxx-3344' the 'xxxx' gets dropped producing 'wa.me/08173344' which is an invalid WA number. Real deployment should store/format phone numbers digits-only. For mock data this still opens WA correctly.
AdminDashboard.jsx PiutangWidget: PIUTANG_ORDERS is a hard-coded module-level constant — fine for mock but will not auto-sync with pendingOrders store. Acceptable since spec says mock data.
POSScreen.jsx reduced from ~1921 to ~1280 lines; modular extraction into /components/pos/* is clean with props-driven state. Good separation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features (CHAT WA on courier motor card, Piutang widget on admin overview with 5 mock rows + WA Tagihan buttons) verified via window.open interception. POS modal refactor verified — no regressions. Tracking modal stage rendering was skipped in this run due to search-input blur timing in my script (non-blocking; covered in prev iterations). Phone-digit-stripping masks 'xxxx' placeholders in mock data — consider using fully-numeric test data if future tests assert exact wa.me/{phone} value.
